svg.text: Start only when needed and deallocate after use
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Azure Virtual Desktop → scaling plan/host pool settings
Review the supported personal-host scaling-plan guide. Configure a limited practice schedule
and the required service-principal RBAC scope; a schedule without permissions cannot stop the
Enable Start VM on Connect where appropriate for your host-pool design and verify its
permissions. Test signing out, deallocation and a later connection that starts the host. It is
not a universal timer and user sessions can affect scale-down.
Until tested automation works, manually Stop/Deallocate the actual VM in Azure after saving
work and signing out. Verify Stopped (deallocated). Guest shutdown/disconnect is not enough,
and disk and license costs can continue.
Check: You observe the real power transition and know which remaining meters still charge.
